a: fn f(v: &mut Vec<u32>) -> Vec<u32> { std::mem::replace(v, Vec::new()) } fn main(){ let mut v = Vec::with_capacity(8); v.push(1u32); let t = f(&mut v); println!("{:?} {} {:?} {}", t, t.capacity(), v, v.capacity()); }
